children: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced crypto and cash holdings of $15.8 billion, including 5.96 million ETH (4.9% of supply).
Holds 5,956,378 ETH valued at $2,513 each, representing 4.9% of the 122.0M ETH supply.
Total crypto + cash & marketable securities + "moonshots" equal $15.8 billion, including $549M cash.
5,067,309 ETH are staked (~$12.7B); projected annualized staking revenues ~$334M (7-day yield 2.62%).
Acquired 27,180 ETH in the past week; weekly ETH purchases since June 30, 2025 as part of treasury strategy.
Company highlights institutional support, MAVAN staking platform expansion, Russell 1000 inclusion and upcoming Tom Lee keynote.
